reviewSamples.author: Photo of Alex
reviewSamples.text: Mediocre taco truck that only accepts cash. I love cash too but it is an inconvenience when you don’t have cash and only have cards on you. The tacos are very dry. I will say it’s a good value for how many tacos you get. We got 7 tacos for 17 which is better then the competitors.
